title: AI ML & Data Science Expert
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced AI, Machine Learning & Data Science Trainer / Industry Expertwho can deliver high-quality, practical and industry-relevant training to students, professionals andcorporate learners.The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, MachineLearning, Data Science, Python and data analytics, along with the ability to explain complex conceptsthrough practical demonstrations, projects and real-world use cases

**Key Responsibilities**

✓ Deliver engaging and practical training sessions in AI, Machine Learning and Data Science.

✓ Develop and update industry-oriented course content, presentations, assignments and practicallabs.

✓ Teach Python programming for AI, ML and Data Science applications.

✓ Explain Machine Learning algorithms, model development, training, evaluation and optimization.

✓ Conduct practical sessions using real-world datasets.

✓ Guide students in developing AI/ML and Data Science projects.

✓ Teach data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis and data visualization.✓ Introduce learners to Generative AI, Large Language Models and modern AI tools.

✓ Demonstrate practical applications of AI across cybersecurity, business, automation and other industries.

✓ Evaluate student performance through assignments, assessments, coding exercises and projects.

✓ Conduct workshops, bootcamps, seminars and corporate training programs.

✓ Mentor students and help them build industry-ready technical skills.

✓ Stay updated with emerging technologies, frameworks, tools and trends in AI/ML/Data Science.

✓ Collaborate with the academic and technical team to continuously improve training quality.

**Technical Skills Required – AI, ML & Data Science**

* **Artificial Intelligence:** AI concepts, Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, AI tools/APIs, AI automation, Responsible AI
* **Machine Learning:** Supervised/Unsupervised Learning, Regression, Classification, Clustering, Decision Trees, Random Forest, Feature Engineering, Model Training & Evaluation, Hyperparameter Tuning, Basic Deep Learning
* **Data Science:** Data Cleaning, EDA, Statistics, Data Preprocessing, Visualization, Predictive Analytics, Real-world Datasets & Business Insights
* **Programming & Tools:** Python, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib/Seaborn, Scikit-learn, Jupyter/Google Colab, SQL, Git/GitHub
* **Advantage:** Familiarity with TensorFlow or PyTorch

Pay: Up to ₹42,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Data Scientist Intern
description:
Worked as a Data Science Intern, applying Python, SQL, statistics, data analysis, and machine learning techniques to real-world datasets. Responsibilities included collecting and cleaning data, performing exploratory data analysis (EDA), identifying patterns and trends, creating visualizations and dashboards, and developing basic machine learning models.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collected, cleaned, and preprocessed structured and unstructured datasets.
* Used Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn for data analysis and visualization.
* Performed exploratory data analysis to identify trends, correlations, and insights.
* Wrote SQL queries to extract and analyze data from databases.
* Built and evaluated machine learning models for prediction and classification tasks.

\*

Education:

* Higher Secondary(12th Pass) (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Data Science Faculty
description:
Job Summery:

A Data Science Trainer is responsible for teaching various modules of Data Science as per the curriculum. They deliver training sessions, prepare learning materials, and assess the progress of learners. The role demands strong expertise in data analytics, programming, machine learning, deep learning, and emerging AI technologies. A Data Science Trainer must be able to simplify complex technical concepts, demonstrate practical applications, and communicate effectively. They play a key rolein shaping learners into skilled data professionals who can work with real-world datasets and industry-relevant tools.

Roles & Responsibilities:

* Conducting classroom or online lectures on Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, AI, SQL, Python, and related technologies.
* Assigning and evaluating practical exercises, projects, and data-driven case studies.
* Guiding students one-on-one with coding support, doubt-solving, and project mentoring.
* Ensuring that the course curriculum is updated, practical, and aligned with current industry needs.
* Collaborating with other trainers and content developers to create and improve training materials.
* Maintaining accurate records of student performance, attendance, and progress reports.
* Creating a positive, engaging, and hands-on learning environment for students.
* Participating in faculty meetings, workshops, and continuous professional development activities.
* Keeping up-to-date with the latest advancements in Data Science tools, frameworks, and technologies.

Job Qualification & Skill Sets:

* A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.
* Minimum 1 year of experience as a Data Science Trainer
* Strong knowledge of Python programming, data analysis libraries and data visualization tools
* Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
* Familiarity with AI concepts, NLP, computer vision, and data preprocessing techniques.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and mentoring skills.
* A passion for teaching and empowering students to build strong careers in Data Science.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team

Email : Sachin.prasad@itvedant.com  
Contact : 8655301282

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
